service_type.description: Systemd service type — 'oneshot' is required because cruft performs a single check and exits

exec_start.description: The executable path for the cruft binary (typically installed as /usr/bin/cruft)

standard_output.description: Where to send stdout; 'journal' is recommended for systemd-managed logging

standard_error.description: Where to send stderr; 'journal' is recommended for systemd-managed logging

syslog_identifier.description: Identifier used when logging to syslog

debug.description: Set DEBUG environment variable to 1 for verbose output from cruft-ng
